title: Hyena-inspired implicit filter generator with Mirror codes
hypothesis: A shared implicit filter basis and per-logical-filter Mirror code can preserve causal convolution outputs at lower payload bytes and compute than independent filters, while any Mirror-specific claim must exceed deterministic sinusoidal codes and native PCA filter coding.
physical_object: Shared position-conditioned long-filter generator for channel-wise causal convolution
mirror_coordinate: Per-task, per-channel coefficient vector over learned temporal filter functions
logical_multiplicity: 16/64 logical filter banks, each evaluated on held-out input sequences

task.metric: Held-out causal convolution output NRMSE, actual serialized inference bytes, filter-generation MAC proxy, FFT MAC proxy and CPU wall time

development.selection_metric: Quality/storage/FFT-compute frontier; Mirror must beat both native sinusoidal codes and native PCA filters

controls: Native deterministic DCT/sinusoidal position code with coefficient table
Learned Mirror PCA filter basis and per-filter codes
Native PCA filter basis with identical decoder

paid_objects: full kernels or learned filter basis

compute: 128 held-out input sequences per world and filter bank
CPU wall time for serialization and inference
success_gate: At residual 0, rank <=8, and both logical-filter counts, Mirror NRMSE <=0.02 and complete bytes <=50% of independent full filters. Mirror-specific success additionally requires a strict quality/byte/compute gain over both deterministic sinusoidal and native PCA controls, without >10% FFT runtime regression.
failure_gate: Quality/byte gate misses or Mirror exactly aliases a native PCA/sinusoidal method without strict frontier gain. Exact development alias permits fresh to remain sealed.
boundaries: Hyena-inspired synthetic filter generator screen only; not a Hyena or language-model reproduction
Teacher filters are generated from eight fixed DCT position functions plus orthogonal residuals
DCT basis values are deterministic from fixed dimensions; basis IDs and all learned/filter-specific state are paid
Causal outputs are evaluated on held-out input sequences, not only kernel reconstruction error
No fresh result may change code rank or filter family
